name: Welcome Gifts
teaser: The gifts given by BSG in one place
description_html:
Description

First! You had any issue? Well, your first step is avoid report it in the comments. These comments will be ignored.
To report a issue please use the SUPPORT THREAD here in the Hub.

About the redistribution:

  • You are NOT allowed to republish, alter or include in a package here or any other sites without my permission.
  • Also, you are NOT allowed to redistribute it in any type of mod-pack. Wherever you host it.

This ‘mod’ was made in cooperation with Senko~

What is this? This mod add custom auto-completable quests. These quests give you the gifts given by BSG in Live. New gifts are added within a maximum period of 1~2 weeks
